label: 🎤 Conference
title: Conference & Simultaneous Interpretation
desc: Professional simultaneous and consecutive interpretation for international conferences, summits, seminars and corporate events across India. Our conference interpreters are trained in ISO-standard booth protocols and work in teams of two for events longer than an hour, so accuracy never drops due to fatigue. We cover 120+ language pairs including German, French, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Spanish, and complete audio equipment — booths, receivers and headsets — can be arranged on request. From diplomatic summits to product launches, Language Guru has supported 2,000+ events since 2005.

label: ⚖️ Legal
title: Legal & Court Interpretation
desc: Certified court interpreters for legal proceedings, arbitrations, depositions, police interviews and immigration hearings. Every legal interpreter on our panel is court-experienced and understands procedural terminology in both languages, so testimony is rendered precisely without summarising or omission. We regularly assist law firms, embassies and government agencies across Delhi NCR and India. All engagements are covered by strict NDAs, and sworn or affidavit-backed interpretation certificates can be issued wherever the court requires them. Same-day emergency assignments are routinely handled.

label: 🏥 Medical
title: Medical & Healthcare Interpretation
desc: Specialist patient-interpreter services for hospitals, clinics, medical tourism providers and clinical research organisations. Our medical interpreters are trained in anatomy, pharmacology and consent-process terminology, enabling clear doctor-patient communication during consultations, surgery counselling and follow-ups. India is a major medical tourism destination, and we routinely support Arabic, Russian, French and Bengali speaking patients at leading hospitals in Delhi, Gurgaon and Chennai. Every assignment is HIPAA and DPDP compliant with complete patient confidentiality, and male or female interpreters can be requested.

label: 💼 Business
title: Business & Corporate Interpretation
desc: Professional business interpreters for negotiations, board meetings, factory audits, trade shows and corporate presentations. Our interpreters combine language mastery with real industry knowledge — manufacturing, IT, pharma, finance — so technical discussions flow naturally without losing nuance. We have supported Indo-German machine installations, Indo-Japanese joint ventures and Chinese supplier audits across Delhi NCR, Pune and Chennai. Interpreters can travel with your team anywhere in India for multi-day, multi-city assignments, and every corporate engagement includes a signed NDA as standard practice.

label: ⚙️ Technical
title: Technical Interpretation — Machine Installation & Commissioning
desc: On-site technical interpreters for machine installation, commissioning, and industrial projects — one of our most in-demand services. When foreign engineers (German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Italian and more) arrive to install or commission machinery, our technical interpreters bridge the communication gap between them and your Indian operations team on the shop floor. They are experienced with engineering terminology, machine manuals, control panels, safety protocols and Factory/Site Acceptance Test (FAT/SAT) procedures, and can be deployed for multi-day and multi-week projects at plants anywhere in India — ensuring installation, trials, operator training and handover happen smoothly without costly misunderstandings.

label: 📞 Remote
title: Telephone & Remote Interpretation
desc: On-demand over-the-phone (OPI) and video remote interpreting (VRI) in 100+ languages — connect with a professional interpreter without travel costs or scheduling delays. Sessions run over Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex or a simple phone call, with average connection time under 60 seconds and 24×7 availability. Ideal for visa interviews, telemedicine consultations, international client calls, online depositions and virtual conferences. Remote interpretation is billed hourly, making it the most economical option, and encrypted lines with optional session recordings keep every call fully confidential.

label: ✈️ Escort
title: Escort & Liaison Interpretation
desc: A personal interpreter for the full duration of a visit, delegation or tour — from airport pickup to final departure. We support foreign executives, government and embassy delegations, factory inspection teams and high-net-worth tourists across multi-day, multi-city itineraries anywhere in India. Escort interpreters handle meetings, site visits, cultural outings and even restaurant conversations, while also providing cultural-protocol guidance and etiquette briefings so nothing is lost between languages. For mixed delegations we assemble multi-language teams under a single coordinator for a seamless experience.
